Question: Janab pls specify we can pay the money as "Hadiya" or gift to hafiz after completing the traweeh. pls note- he did'nt demand any such type of money or any other benefits against his completing the traweeh? i want to pay my self without any demand. Answer ID: 16555 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1594/1266/L=1430) It is not allowed to give gift to a hafiz after completion of tarawih; since what is common is just like conditioned. One who wants to help the hafiz, they can do so in any other month of the year. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
